hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in "$root/go.sum"|"$root/grove") echo "Blocked: $(basename "$f") must not be hand-edited" 1>&2; exit 2 ;; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.go) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$root" && go vet ./... 1>&2 || exit 2; }
